at_spi_bus_address.description: D-Bus session bus address used by AT-SPI. Usually auto-detected; set only if non-standard session.

at_spi_registry.description: Enable AT-SPI registry daemon. Required for assistive technologies to discover accessibility services.

atk_bridge_path.description: Absolute path to the ATK bridge shared library. Adjust for your architecture or distro.

qt_accessibility.description: Enable Qt accessibility support. Set to false only if accessibility features conflict with your setup.

qtwebengine_chromium_flags.description: Chromium flags passed to Qt WebEngine. Include accessibility flags if required by your assistive tech.

env_overrides.description: Per-application environment overrides (e.g., for custom AT clients or containers). Each entry defines a name and key=value pairs.

values.description: Environment variable key-value pairs to apply for this application.
